gbm_population_evidence.quote: Imaging or needle biopsy pathologically diagnosed as glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: [PROCEDURE] interventional procedure to block bilateral meningeal blood supply
The embolic agent used in bilateral meningeal blood supply occlusion through interventional surgery is Onyx glue ("liquid embolic system").

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients have not previously received radiotherapy, chemotherapy and other treatment modalities for intracranial lesions

coder_notes: Procedure-only trial: middle meningeal artery embolization with Onyx liquid embolic system (a device) before resection. No drug or biologic intervention registered; Onyx not listed as an agent. Registered phase NA.
